name: settings-page
title: Settings Page
description: SettingsPage: a section navigation that sticks beside the sections on wide containers and becomes a section picker on narrow ones, marking the section being read (IntersectionObserver). Going to a section scrolls by id and focuses its heading, so it works under hash routers; the section can live in the URL through createUrlParam. SettingsSection, SettingsRow (a label, a description and the control on the right, stacking when narrow), SettingsFacts (a DescriptionList for read-only facts) and SettingsDangerZone with SettingsDangerAction rows that confirm through ConfirmDialog and need a person's approval for agents.
docs: `<SettingsPage url={createUrlParam("section")} style={{ "--settings-top": "var(--topbar-height)" }}><SettingsSection id="security" title="Security" description="…" actions={…}><SettingsRow label="Two-factor authentication" description="…"><Switch /></SettingsRow></SettingsSection><SettingsSection id="device" title="This device"><SettingsFacts aria-label="This device"><DescriptionItem>…</DescriptionItem></SettingsFacts></SettingsSection><SettingsDangerZone id="danger" title="Danger zone"><SettingsDangerAction label trigger title confirmLabel agentConfirm onConfirm /></SettingsDangerZone></SettingsPage>`. The navigation lists every direct `SettingsSection` child with a text title (`navLabel` otherwise), or pass `sections`. `--settings-top` is the height of anything sticky above the page and `--settings-height` the box that scrolls it. `currentSection` and `onSectionChange` (reason `scroll`, `nav` or `url`) follow your own state. The navigation's links take their href from the `url` adapter (`createUrlParam("section", { router: hashRouter() })` gives `#/settings?section=id`, which opens the right route in a new tab), else `#id`; `getHref` overrides it, and `navigation="buttons"` renders buttons that only scroll, for sections with no address. A `SettingsRow` is a `Field` that names a UI SDK control; `field={false}` for a button. Labels `nav` and `jump` are overridable.
